comment: Ground truth: intervene = the agent should be told the call did not do what was intended; ok = result is fine. Genuinely ambiguous cases (wrong-file-read; m3-rolldown-ts, which shows a real typecheck error the task asked to surface) are excluded. Gate = fail-recall (intervene cases caught); falseFireRate (ok cases nagged) is advisory. The compound cat;grep case is the measured run-5 A0 false fire of the single-question policy (live failed=0.86) that the error/empty decomposition suppresses.
